# glow.eu.org
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Glow by Mariam</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--mint:#B9D6C4;--mint-d:#8FBBA2;--white:#fff;--egg:#F8F4EC;--beige:#EFE6D8;--pink:#F7DCE0;--apricot:#F1B8A3;--sky:#DCEEF0;--gold:#B8862B;--ink:#33302C;--soft:#6A625A;--line:rgba(51,48,44,.12)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:300;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-weight:500;margin:0}
p{line-height:1.7;color:var(--soft);margin:0 0 1em}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img{max-width:100%;display:block}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
.announce{background:var(--ink);color:var(--egg);text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:9px 10px}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:84px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer}.brand svg{width:48px;height:48px}
.brand .n1{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:23px;line-height:1}.brand .n2{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.28em;color:var(--gold);margin-top:3px;display:block}
.links{display:flex;gap:32px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.links button{font-size:14px;color:var(--soft);padding:6px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.25s}
.links button:hover,.links button.on{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--gold)}
.burger{display:none;font-size:13px;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;padding:8px 16px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 30px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;transition:.3s}
.btn.dark{background:var(--ink);color:var(--egg)}.btn.dark:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.light{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}.btn.light:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.line:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--egg)}
.eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:14px}
.page{display:none}.page.on{display:block;animation:f .45s ease}@keyframes f{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1}}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:88vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;background:var(--sky)}
.hero>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hero:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,0) 35%,rgba(30,28,26,.55))}
.hero .in{position:relative;z-index:2;color:#fff;padding-bottom:70px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,6.4vw,84px);font-style:italic;line-height:1;max-width:760px;color:#fff}
.hero p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);max-width:470px;margin:20px 0 28px}
.hero .eyebrow{color:var(--pink)}
.ticker{background:var(--sky);overflow:hidden;padding:15px 0;border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.tr{display:flex;gap:56px;white-space:nowrap;width:max-content;animation:sc 30s linear infinite;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:19px;color:#2f6f78}
@keyframes sc{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.sec{padding:100px 0}.head{text-align:center;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 52px}.head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);font-style:italic}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}
.grid2 h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:18px}
.photo{border-radius:20px;width:100%;object-fit:cover}
.badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:20px}
.badge{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink)}
.blue{background:var(--sky)}.egg{background:var(--egg)}.mint{background:var(--mint)}
/* products */
.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;transition:.35s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 22px 40px rgba(51,48,44,.12)}
.pv{aspect-ratio:1/1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.pv img.jar{width:52%;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18))}.pv img.cover{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.pi{padding:20px 22px 24px}.tag{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold)}
.pi h3{font-size:23px;margin:6px 0}.pi p{font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ing{font-size:12px;color:#2f6f78;margin-bottom:14px!important}
.pf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.price{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:20px}
.add{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ink);transition:.25s}.add:hover,.add.done{background:var(--ink);color:var(--egg)}
.pill{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:40px 0 0}
.pill button{padding:10px 22px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--soft)}.pill button.on,.pill button:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--egg)}
.phead{padding:110px 0 64px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.phead h1{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,62px);font-style:italic}.phead p{max-width:540px;margin:16px auto 0}
/* shoot gallery */
.shoot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;height:540px}.shoot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:560px}.split .img{position:relative;overflow:hidden}.split .img img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.split .tx{padding:90px 64px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}.split h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.2vw,42px);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:16px}
.pillars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}.pillar{border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:4px solid var(--mint-d);border-radius:18px;padding:32px 26px;background:#fff}
.pillar h3{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 10px}.pillar p{font-size:13.5px;margin:0}
.stats{background:var(--ink);padding:74px 0}.stats .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;text-align:center}
.stats b{display:block;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:46px;color:var(--apricot);font-weight:500}.stats span{font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(248,244,236,.72)}
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
.cc{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;min-height:440px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:30px;color:#fff}
.cc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.cc:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 35%,rgba(30,28,26,.68))}
.cc div{position:relative;z-index:2}.cc h3{font-size:28px;font-style:italic;color:#fff;margin:6px 0}.cc p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);font-size:13.5px;margin:0}.cc .tag{color:var(--pink)}
.chero{position:relative;min-height:70vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.chero>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.chero:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(30,28,26,.38)}
.chero div{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:620px;padding:0 24px}.chero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6vw,70px);font-style:italic;color:#fff}.chero p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);margin:14px 0 26px}
/* story */
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:72px;align-items:center;padding:90px 0}.row.rev>:first-child{order:2}
.row h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:18px}.row img{border-radius:20px;width:100%;height:480px;object-fit:cover}
.list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:20px 0 0;display:grid;gap:12px}.list li{display:flex;gap:12px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--soft)}.list li:before{content:'';width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);margin-top:9px;flex:none}
.quote{padding:110px 0;text-align:center}.quote blockquote{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,40px);max-width:800px;margin:0 auto 18px;line-height:1.35}.quote cite{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--gold);font-style:normal}
.news{background:var(--apricot);padding:84px 0;text-align:center}.news h2{color:#fff;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px);margin-bottom:12px}.news p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);max-width:470px;margin:0 auto 26px}
.nf{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto}.nf input{flex:1;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;font-family:inherit}.nf input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:var(--egg);padding:80px 0 28px}.fg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:44px;padding-bottom:50px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(248,244,236,.15)}
footer p{color:rgba(248,244,236,.65);font-size:13.5px;max-width:280px}footer h4{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--apricot);margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:500}footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}footer li button{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(248,244,236,.78)}
.fb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}.fb svg{width:42px;height:42px}.fb span{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:22px}.copy{padding-top:24px;font-size:12px;color:rgba(248,244,236,.5);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
@media(max-width:900px){.links{display:none;position:absolute;top:84px;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;flex-direction:column;padding:16px 28px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:12px}.links.open{display:flex}.burger{display:block}
.grid2,.split,.row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}.row.rev>:first-child{order:0}.split .tx{padding:56px 28px}.pgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.pillars{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.cgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.shoot{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;height:auto}.shoot img{height:260px}.fg{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.row img{height:340px}}
@media(max-width:560px){.pgrid,.pillars{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wrap{padding:0 20px}.fg{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>

    <div class="pillar"><h3>Avocado oil</h3><p>Deeply nourishing, full of vitamin E and oleic acid for dry skin.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Coconut</h3><p>Virgin coconut oil and water for softness and light hydration.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Raw honey</h3><p>A natural humectant that draws moisture in and soothes.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Milk</h3><p>Oat and goat milk proteins for a gentle, lactic-acid glow.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Jojoba &amp; shea</h3><p>Skin-like jojoba and rich shea butter to seal in comfort.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Aloe &amp; chamomile</h3><p>Cooling botanicals that calm redness and post-sun skin.</p></div>

<!-- SUSTAINABILITY -->
<main id="p-sustainability" class="page">
  <section class="phead blue"><div class="wrap"><span class="eyebrow">Gentle on skin and planet</span><h1>Sustainability</h1><p>Simple choices, made on purpose, from the plants we use to the jar they arrive in.</p></div></section>
  <section class="sec"><div class="wrap"><div class="pillars">
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Bamboo jars</h3><p>Fast-growing, renewable bamboo outer shells with a recyclable glass inner.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Refill, don't replace</h3><p>Send the empty jar back or buy a refill pouch and keep the bamboo.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Reef-safe formulas</h3><p>Everything rinses clean to the sea. No microplastics, no harsh filters.</p></div>
    <div class="pillar"><h3>Small-batch sourcing</h3><p>Honey, fruit oils and butters come from named growers, not anonymous supply chains.</p></div>
  </div></div></section>
  <section class="split"><div class="img"><img data-img="jarraw" alt="Bamboo packaging jar"></div><div class="tx blue"><span class="eyebrow">Packaging</span><h2>A jar worth keeping.</h2><p>Our bamboo shells are sealed with water-based finishes and fitted with a reusable glass liner. We ship in recycled cardboard boxes printed with plant-based ink, packed with paper instead of plastic.</p></div></section>
  <section class="split"><div class="tx egg"><span class="eyebrow">Ingredients</span><h2>Grown, not manufactured.</h2><p>We buy cold-pressed oils, raw honey and butters from small producers and favour by-products that would otherwise go to waste, like leftover pomegranate seeds and fruit pressings.</p></div><div class="img"><img data-img="avojar" alt="Avocados in a basket"></div></section>
  <section class="stats"><div class="wrap"><div><b>100%</b><span>plant-based ingredients</span></div><div><b>0</b><span>plastic fillers in shipping</span></div><div><b>1%</b><span>of sales to beach cleanups</span></div><div><b>2×</b><span>refills per jar, at least</span></div></div></section>
</main>

<!-- STORY -->
<main id="p-story" class="page">
  <section class="chero" style="min-height:66vh"><img data-img="hammock" alt="Hammock between palm trees"><div><span class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--pink)">Our story</span><h1>I just wanted to understand what I was putting on my face.</h1></div></section>
  <section class="wrap"><div class="row"><div><span class="eyebrow">Where it began</span><h2>Natural on the front, confusing on the back.</h2>
    <p>For years I picked up jars and bottles, turned them over and squinted at long lists of names I didn't recognise. The front promised pure and gentle. The back told a different story, with perfumes, fillers and preservatives tucked in between the good ingredients.</p>
    <p>All I really wanted was a label I could read to the end and understand.</p></div>
    <img data-img="coconut" alt="Fresh coconuts on a beach table"></div></section>
  <section class="egg"><div class="wrap"><div class="row rev"><div><span class="eyebrow">My ingredient list</span><h2>Only what I'd happily name.</h2>
    <p>So I wrote down the ingredients I actually wanted in my routine, and left everything else out.</p>
    <ul class="list"><li>Rosehip oil for brightening and even tone</li><li>Pomegranate oil for antioxidants and a healthy-looking glow</li><li>Avocado oil for deep, lasting moisture</li><li>Coconut for softness and gentle hydration</li><li>Raw honey and milk to soothe and soften</li></ul></div>
    <img data-img="avojar" alt="Bamboo jar among avocados"></div></div></section>
  <section class="wrap"><div class="row"><div><span class="eyebrow">A natural way of living</span><h2>Skincare was only the beginning.</h2>
    <p>Once I started reading labels, I couldn't stop. I swapped my kitchen cleaners, cooked from scratch more often, and spent more time outside: early swims, slow walks, afternoons in a hammock.</p>
    <p>Glow by Mariam is that same slower, simpler way of living, made small enough to keep on your shelf. A few good ingredients, a routine you actually enjoy, and a little more time in the sun.</p></div>
    <img data-img="pool1" alt="Lagoon with palm trees"></div></section>
  <section class="quote blue"><div class="wrap"><blockquote>"If I wouldn't put it on my plate, I don't want it on my skin."</blockquote><cite>MARIAM, FOUNDER</cite></div></section>
</main>

</script>
